title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・光を浴びて

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I did it! I—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Riiice! You were aaaawesooome!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-Urara?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee, yep! Here I am!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You shouldn't be! We can't be here—this is the winner's circle!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Only the winner and her team are allowed to stand here!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In that case, no problem detected. We are all Team Rice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That was a superb race, Rice. You have my congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: During your race, Rob Roy called you a tenacious demon. My own observations found that name quite fitting.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A tenacious demon?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Bourbon! I told you to keep that a secret!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It looks like I managed to live up to everyone's expectations this race!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I did, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! And you're smiling too! You better keep it up for the winning concert!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: We'll be there too, waving our arms until they fly off!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thanks, Urara. I'll find you in the crowd… and wave back.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A really… really big wave, so you'll see it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …That said, I'm way too nervous!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: To think I would take center stage at the spring Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed. As the runner who defeated me, you must hold yourself with more dignity.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: M-McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Without a doubt, this stage is a special one. Yet we are professionals when it comes to performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: There is but one thing you must convey to all the people who have come here to see you today… and that is your gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: My… gratitude?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. On the stage, we Umamusume give thanks to those who have supported us and pushed us forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Put another way, the stage is not something to be feared.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: As the winner, it is an extension of your duty to shine onstage for those who have lifted you up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Which is to say, I'm looking forward to seeing how you shine after such an extraordinary race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Understood!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Mejiro McQueen heads to the stage with elegance and grace.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah… She's incredible.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I need to follow her example. I must meet everyone's expectations in order to show how grateful I am…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: She's right, after all… Bourbon and the other racers aren't the only reason I've gotten this far…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There are also all the people… who watch my races and support me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: All right… Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower runs off toward the glittering stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later in the evening…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um… I'm sorry to bring this up when we just got back, but…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've decided what I want to do next!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've decided what I want to do next!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um… I want to live up to my fans' expectations even more.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I saw so many lights while I was standing on the stage.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I couldn't believe it… So many people made me feel like a star.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So… if my fans will allow it, I want to compete in the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen—a race in which only fan-favorites can compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Who would have thought this girl, who I once found crying alone on campus, would now be more than qualified for such a race?
choice_data_list: Then let's race in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… Yep! I'm going to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That should show everyone…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: How grateful I am.
